conf.description: Forescout eyeSight/CounterACT eyeExtend for QRadar LEEF feed (nac-event, syslog-leef): structured tab-delimited attribute decode, no Elastic/Cribl-pack parser exists for LEEF.

conf.comment: nac-event/syslog-leef: eyeExtend LEEF module output. Splits the 5-segment CEF-style pipe header, then extracts the known tab-delimited key=value attributes independently (order not assumed). srcMAC normalized colon->dash uppercase; devTime parsed via auto_timestamp's heuristic detection (devTimeFormat is informational only per vendor note to drop it, not consumed - README gap: no format-string-driven parse implemented). sev (1-10 LEEF scale) cast to event.severity as-is.

functions.description: why LEEF gets a dedicated attribute decoder
Split the 5 pipe-delimited LEEF header segments from the attribute tail
Extract LEEF tab-delimited attribute cat (generic classification)
Extract LEEF tab-delimited attribute sev (1-10 LEEF severity)
Extract LEEF tab-delimited attribute src (observed endpoint IP)
Extract LEEF tab-delimited attribute srcMAC (observed endpoint MAC)
Extract LEEF tab-delimited attribute usrName (associated user)
Extract LEEF tab-delimited attribute domain (endpoint NT/AD domain)
Extract LEEF tab-delimited attribute identHostName (endpoint host name)
Extract LEEF tab-delimited attribute devTime (raw appliance event time)
Extract LEEF tab-delimited attribute devTimeFormat (format specifier for devTime)
batch every status:mapped/custom field that needed no further transform
Best-effort: auto_timestamp's format heuristics parse devTime without consuming the paired devTimeFormat spec string; validate against real samples (README gap)
srcMAC normalization, LEEF severity cast, event.dataset, cleanup (devTimeFormat dropped per vendor note, not indexed)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
